title: Sharp-cube scalar-budget obstruction and the Class-II gauge-null pivot
scope: The strict dyadic sharp rectangular-cube filtration on T_L^3 with L=16, three complex components in the six-real convention, all three derivative directions, the A1 production coefficients, fixed positive density floor, and the A11 adapted source. The negative result applies to the separated H6=M6^4 Q6^2 route and to the coefficient-blind scalar envelope after |B(u)Du|<=beta_op|u|^2|Du|; it does not refute the exact-B shell-localised source.

riesz_projection_theorem.authors: Brian Hollenbeck and Igor E. Verbitsky
riesz_projection_theorem.title: Best constants for the Riesz projection
riesz_projection_theorem.imported_statement: For 1<p<infinity, the Riesz projection on the circle has norm csc(pi/p*) with p*=max(p,p/(p-1)); in particular the L6 norm is 2.

geometry.target_space: six real field components and three spatial derivative directions

theorem.boundary_modulation: For every fixed finite trigonometric polynomial F and sufficiently large dyadic N, S_N[e^(i alpha N(x1+x2+x3))F]=e^(i alpha N(x1+x2+x3)) P_<=0^(tensor 3)F.
theorem.square_lower: The one-scale carrier derivative gives Q6>=sqrt(3)||P_<=0^(tensor 3)||_6>=8sqrt(3), hence Q6^2>=192.
theorem.scalar_envelope_lower: The coefficient-blind scalar six-linear envelope constant is at least 3*8^6=786432; its one-axis restriction is already at least 2^6=64.
theorem.gauge_null: With J the real global-phase complex structure, p_A^T JX=v_A^T JX=0 and therefore B(X)JX=0 exactly, including the fixed floor.
lost_structures: the exact Class-II B gauge-null direction
the output shell projection on B(S_(j-1)phi) D S_(j-1)phi

budget.interpretation: Both the finite exact witness and the sharp asymptotic lower bound exceed the source-only target, so no admissible upper enclosure of H6 can satisfy it.

finite_rational_witness.description: A complex trigonometric polynomial g=sum_(n=-10)^10 c_n z^n with common denominator 10^10. The stored pairs are Gaussian-integer numerators (Re c_n, Im c_n).
finite_rational_witness.certificate_formula: ||g||_6^6=sum_k |(c*c*c)_k|^2 exactly; project by retaining n<=0; the three-dimensional carrier lower is 3*(||P_<=0 g||_6^6/||g||_6^6)^3.
finite_rational_witness.purpose: An elementary finite-integer countercertificate independent of the external sharp Riesz norm.

required_checks: exact Riesz tensor and carrier constants
dyadic shift identity and terminal-cutoff admissibility
B(X)JX=0 by real-matrix and current formulations
the distinction between coefficient-blind no-go and the open exact-B source

consequence.no_overclaim: This package does not refute the exact A11 source, prove a coefficient-aware shell-localised bound, establish a positive sextic reserve, close the stabilised log-Laplace or Nelson gates, construct an interacting measure, or justify T5, T6, or T7.
